valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E. At the 12-month target date (Nov 2027) an investor prices roughly next-twelve-month adjusted EPS, about 1/6 FY2028 (Jan-2028 year end) and 5/6 FY2029. Base: FY2028 adj. EPS $3.22 (+13% on the $2.80-2.87 FY2027 guide, midpoint $2.835) and FY2029 $3.60 (+12%), blended NTM about $3.50. Model assumptions, not company guidance. USD listing, no ADR conversion.

bear.driver: US comps stay near the six-year low seen in Q2 FY27, tariff-refund tailwind fades, EPS growth about 5% a year

base.driver: Guided FY27 adj. EPS $2.80-2.87, then about 12-13% annual growth from sales growth of 4-5% and operating income growing faster than sales (advertising, membership, e-commerce profit)

bull.driver: Operating income compounds 15%+, mix shift to advertising/membership holds premium multiple

valuation.implied_by_close: At base NTM EPS $3.50 the $128.09 close implies 36.6x; the base 36x multiple gives $126. A target of $145 (the latest JPMorgan call) needs 41.4x at $3.50 or about $4.03 EPS at 36x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.50 (2.7 pp of return on the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Walmart U.S. comparable sales growth ex-fuel and adjusted operating income growth versus the 2-4% Q3 guide; a sustained comp below about 4% would break the base case.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q3 FY2027 earnings, scheduled for 2026-11-19 (guide: adj. EPS $0.62-0.64, net sales +3-3.75% cc).

analyst_notes: Four named analysts found. After the Aug 20 Q2 report (stock -9% to $103.84) Goldman cut $141 to $130, BofA $144 to $126 and Argus $145 to $130, all keeping Buy; JPMorgan then raised $125 to $145 on Nov 9. Targets of $126-145 bracket the $126 base; JPMorgan's $145 needs about 41x or about $4.03 EPS versus the model. No target horizons were verified, so none enter the weighted target; the sample is small and 3 of 4 are the same-day post-earnings cuts.
